title: The Plink Under the Eaves
synopsis: From a dry Story House, the friends trace a rainy plink to drops hitting a watering can and add its picture to their book.
continuity_state: Before: Blue sound book has four filled pages; Reed Meadow/Todd known; Ben brings book to Story House but will take it home. After: Fifth book page records drip on metal watering can, with plink written by Grandma May; rain stops; sixth page remains blank; book returns home with Ben.
